title: Thumbnail Analyst: documentary long-video and Shorts thumbnails

criteria.check: The headline matches the requested text exactly, every word, number and punctuation mark, and no other text, sign or lettering appears in the picture.
criteria.why: Viewers and YouTube's policies punish misleading or garbled text.

criteria.check: The headline reads at phone size (about 200 px wide): 2 to 5 words, the number or key word larger, thick outline, strong contrast with the area behind it.
criteria.why: A thumbnail is judged in a feed, not full screen.

criteria.check: The picture communicates the video's central conflict, achievement, mystery or statistic in about one second, and reinforces the headline.
criteria.why: The click decision takes about a second.

criteria.check: One dominant hero subject fills about 35-50% of the storytelling area, sharply separated from the background, with at most 1-3 smaller supporting elements.
criteria.why: Several equal subjects read as clutter at small size.

criteria.check: Nothing contradicts the plan's accuracy notes or the era: people, vehicles, uniforms, buildings and technology are period-correct and the scene does not misrepresent the story.
criteria.why: Anachronisms and misleading images cost trust and invite comments.

criteria.check: Real people, machines and places that the reference images show look like them (faces, costumes, shapes, proportions).
criteria.why: A thumbnail that shows someone who is not in the video misleads.

criteria.check: 16:9: nothing essential in the bottom-right corner (duration badge). 9:16: the headline in the upper 10-35% band and nothing essential near the edges or the bottom interface.
No distorted faces, malformed hands, duplicated subjects, cropped subjects or cropped letters, and no visible generation artefacts.
criteria.why: Defects read as low quality at a glance.

criteria.check: Dramatic directional light, rich shadows with detail, complementary warm and cool colours, vivid but controlled saturation.
criteria.why: Flat light and muddy colour disappear in the feed.

criteria.check: The Shorts' thumbnails differ from each other and from the long video's, each matching its own angle (hook, stat, twist).
criteria.why: Identical covers waste the extra chances to be clicked.
